is a light-patterned board with wooden borders. The board is placed in the middle of a child's bedroom. The bedroom has a brown wooden floor, green walls and a white ceiling. On the walls there was a window, brown wooden door and a light switch. There was also a green carpet in the middle of the room. There are multiple toys scattered across the board and carpet. Most of them are colorful plastic and wooden building bricks, and jigsaw puzzle pieces. A toy fire truck, toy ambulance, toy police car, teddy bear, two cans of cola, one spilled, and Roblox mystery figure boxes all can also be found here. A massive brick castle stands prominently at one edge of the board, complete with a blue flag.

There is also furniture in the room. To the left of the window, there is a brown wooden bed with a green pillow and blanket. There is also a brown wooden drawer next to the bed. Under the window, there is a white radiator. To the right of the window, there are three boxes placed underneath a table. To the left of the door, there are two boxes, one blue and the other red. To the right of the door, there is a brown wooden bookshelf. There is also a green box between the bookshelf and bed.

The building brick path starts at the Roblox mystery figure boxes and ends at the toy castle. It takes arbitrary corners, which means it cuts back on itself several times.

An Easter egg was once found with BelowNatural's X (known as Twitter at the time) handle on the back of the castle.
On the first version of the castle, there used to be a picture of BelowNatural. The Twitter handle was also outdated on that version of the map.
shows an unused version of it.
Most notably, the playing cards are still on the side of the map, while in-game they are placed in the middle of the map.
On the icon, there is a cliff spot to the right of the entrance, which was also present on the first version of the map. This cliff spot is not present in-game.
In-game, there are two cliff spots near the exit, one large to the left of it and one smaller to the right of it. On the icon only the larger cliff spot is present.
The cola cans are much closer to the path than they are in-game. In-game, they are on the corner of the board, while on the icon they are behind one of the cliff spots.
third version had two unusual cliff spots near the edges of the map.
The first is a few blocks placed on the edge of the map, near the plush bear. These cliff spots are one of the lowest in the entire game, being very close to the ground.
The second is an invisible brick near the soda cans, which counts as a cliff spot. This means cliff towers can be placed on nothing and float midair.
As both of these spots are placed at the edges of the map, most cliff towers were unable to reach the path from them.
